notes: The manifest is the single machine authority for protected core modules.

All 13 protected modules live under domain/ (src package restructure, ADR-0007); forbidden_internal_modules now names the impure subpackages (data/services/ui/qt_app) rather than individual module filenames, since a domain/ module's cross-package relative import resolves to from ..<subpackage>.<mod> and the checker inspects only the first path component.
workflow.py (now services/workflow.py) remains application orchestration and must move provider exceptions behind a future port in WI-007/WI-009.
